Le retour de la plateforme sous haute su: The return of the platform under close surveillance
Le ministère de la Poste et des Télécomm: On Tuesday, October 13, 2026, the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications formalized the lifting of the ban imposed in September 2025 against the online gaming platform Roblox. This decision comes after in-depth discussions between ministerial services and platform representatives, focusing on terms of use and digital security requirements.
Les autorités algériennes privilégient d: Algerian authorities now favor a regulated opening that balances the development of digital activities with the imperative protection of users. The Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Sid Ali Zerrouki, has made the protection of children in the virtual space a national priority, while supporting access to the services of international web giants subject to formal guarantees.
Plusieurs obligations techniques ont ain: Several technical obligations have thus been formulated against the game's publisher. Among them is the integration of a secure age-estimation mechanism to adjust accessible virtual worlds and prevent exposure to inappropriate experiences. Parental control tools have also been reinforced, giving guardians the ability to supervise minors' activity, restrict connection time, monitor spending, and apply age filters on content.
En outre, les exigences institutionnelle: In addition, institutional requirements include better support for the Arabic language and the Algerian dialect, as well as the reinforcement of reporting mechanisms to quickly identify offensive posts and ensure respect for local social and cultural values.
Concernant les communications, la messag: Regarding communications, Roblox's internal messaging remains completely inactive for all users connecting from the country. This suspension will continue until the implementation of advanced text and voice moderation tools compatible with national regulatory requirements and capable of efficiently processing exchanges.
Rétablissement officiel de l'accès à Rob: Official restoration of access to Roblox in Algeria enacted on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, by the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications.
La fonction de discussion (chat) demeure: The chat feature remains disabled throughout the national territory pending suitable moderation systems.
Instauration de nouveaux outils de contr: Introduction of new parental control tools allowing parents to limit playtime, track spending, and filter content by age.
Exigence d'une amélioration de la prise: Requirement for improved support for the Arabic language and the Algerian dialect to more effectively identify problematic content.
Le ministre Sid Ali Zerrouki qualifie la: Minister Sid Ali Zerrouki describes the protection of children in the digital space as a national priority.
